banner.title: prowlarr
banner.tagline: Central Usenet indexer manager: one set of indexers, synced to every *arr app, on its own PostgreSQL 18 database.

steps.title: Database
steps.text: The prowlarr-db Kustomization creates role and database prowlarr on the shared postgres-18 Cluster. The app's settings and indexers live there.
steps.scene: a database cylinder with a labelled drawer

steps.title: Secret
steps.text: ExternalSecret prowlarr-secret carries the database settings and the API key from the 1Password items prowlarr and cloudnative-pg.
steps.scene: a key being cut from a vault blank

steps.title: Index
steps.text: Prowlarr queries the Usenet indexers you configured and hands results to the *arr apps. Torrent indexers are not configured, by decision.
steps.scene: a hub with cyan cables fanning out to four app nodes

steps.title: Keep
steps.text: The 5Gi prowlarr-config claim is backed up by kopiur to Ceph and R2. Backups run as UID 3002 and GID 3000.
steps.scene: an indexer card sealed in an archive box

art.about: an indexer manager that holds Usenet indexers once and syncs them to several downstream apps
art.title: How Prowlarr shares indexers
